meaning: someone who has seen very little and thinks it is all there is

story.zh: 一只青蛙住在井里。它看见的天，只有井口那么大。它说：“天就这么大！”
story.en: A frog lived at the bottom of a well. The sky it saw was only as big as the well's mouth, so it said: 'The sky is this big!'

pinyin: sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī
meaning: walk with any two others and one of them can teach you something — there is always someone to learn from

story.zh: 孔子说：三个人一起走，里面一定有一个人，可以做我的老师。
story.en: Confucius said: when three people walk together, one of them is sure to be someone I can learn from.

meaning: heaven's secrets must not be told — said with a wink by fortune tellers who don't know the answer

story.zh: 算命的人常说：天机不可泄露。意思是：我不能告诉你。
story.en: Fortune tellers love to say it: heaven's secrets must not be told. It means: I can't tell you.
